title: AMD Stock Trends Following Q2 Earnings Report
description: AMD stock is trending as the company's Q2 earnings report shows significant growth in data center revenue and AI-linked GPU sales.

sections.heading: AMD Earnings Report
paragraphs: AMD's Q2 earnings report has been released, highlighting a more than doubling of data center revenue to $6.7 billion, according to Stock Titan.

sections.heading: Market Reaction
paragraphs: Despite the positive earnings report, AMD's stock price slipped, as noted by Seeking Alpha, which attributes this to the market's high expectations and the performance of chips and momentum stocks.

sections.heading: Options Market Insights
paragraphs: CNBC reports that AMD's earnings are a key test for chips and momentum stocks, and the options market is closely watching the results.

faq.q: What was AMD's data center revenue in Q2?
faq.a: According to Stock Titan, AMD's data center revenue more than doubled to $6.7 billion in Q2.

faq.q: How did AMD's stock perform after the Q2 earnings report?
faq.a: Seeking Alpha notes that AMD's stock price slipped even after the positive Q2 results, possibly due to high market expectations.
